cmd.duct.help: Dweba umugqa wepayipi lomoya ngomugqa wawo maphakathi: izigoba, izinguqukosi nezixhumanisi zamagatsha zifika zodwa
cmd.ductsize.help: Linganisa ingxenye yomugqa wepayipi lomoya ngokugeleza komoya (ukuphikisana okulinganayo), noma bhala usayizi wawo noma isimo sawo
cmd.ductcalc.help: Isibali-mpilo samapayipi lomoya: usayizi ozungezayo, obunxantathu nowe-flat oval ngokugeleza komoya nezinga lokuphikiswa
cmd.ductsched.help: Uhlu lwamapayipi lomoya: ubude, izixhumanisi nendawo yensimbi yeshidi, ibekwe njengethebula elizibuyekeza lona
cmd.duct3d.help: Akha futhi izinto ezinemithamo zawo wonke amamgqa wamapayipi lomoya kuthebhu ye-3D
ask.duct.first: Iphoyinti lokuqala lomugqa wepayipi lomoya ({size}); qala ngaphakathi kwepayipi ukuze ugatshulele kulo

ask.which: Shintsha le ngxenye noma umugqa wonke
ask.table: Lapho uthebula liya khona (ikhona yalo ngakwesobunxele phezulu)
done.duct: Umugqa wepayipi lomoya udwetshiwe: izingxenye {n}. Uqala: {size}.
done.table: Uthebula lubekiwe. Lulandela amapayipi njengoba eshintsha.
done.3d: Izinto ezinemithamo zakhiwe futhi kwemigqa yamapayipi lomoya: {n}.
done.3d.off: Izinto ezinemithamo zivaliwe kuZilungiselelo › CadCraft › HVAC.
calc.exact: {q} {qu} ngezinga {rate} {ru}, izinto: {mat}. Ipayipi elizungezayo lobubanzi {d} {unit} ngokuqondile.
warn.aspect: Izinhlangothi zalo: {a} ku-1. Ngaphezu kuka-4 ku-1 kubiza kakhulu ensimbini nokucindezela; cabangela ipayipi eliphakeme.
warn.short: Ingxenye imfishane kakhulu kwezixhumanisi zayo: ziyahlangana. Hambisa iphoyinti noma sebenzisa izigoba ezincane.
warn.hairpin: Umugqa uphenduka ubuyele kuwo ngekhona: akukho gobo elingadwetshwa lapho.
warn.maxpts: Umugqa unamaphoyinti angu-100 kuphela: lo uphela lapha. Qala umugqa omusha kusukela ekupheleni kwawo.
err.size: Lokho akusona usayizi: bhala ububanzi × ukuphakama (24x12) noma idayamitha (14).
err.sized: Akukho usayizi wepayipi olwanele ukugeleza komoya ngalelo zinga lokuphikiswa.
err.run: Lo mugqa awukwazi ukudwetshwa: udinga amaphoyinti amabili ahlukile nosayizi wengxenye ngayinye.
err.newer: Lo mugqa wenziwa i-add-on entsha ye-HVAC: uhlala njengoba unjalo.
pack.name: Amapayipi kumdwebo: {name}
pack.description: Izakhiwo zepayipi nezixhumanisi zomdwebo oyedwa we-CadCraft, nensimbi yeshidi edingekayo ngayinye. Azikho izinga: ibeke elakho.
pack.assume.duct: Insimbi yeshidi = umjikelezo wepayipi × ubude bawo; izixhumi, izingxenye ezigqagqene nokulahlekelwa azifakiwe: zengeze njengokulahlekelwa.
pack.assume.fitting: Insimbi yeshidi ngesixhumanisi ngasinye = umjikelezo wawo × ubude bomugqa wawo maphakathi (ukunemba kumagoba ajikelezile; akhelene nezinguqukosi).
pack.source.drawn: Insimbi yeshidi ibalwe ngosayizi abadwetshiwe: umjikelezo × ubude bomugqa maphakathi
panel.facts: Imigqa yamapayipi lomoya: {n}. {len} {lu} aqondile, izixhumanisi {f}, {area} {au} yensimbi yeshidi.
panel.none: Akukho mugqa wamapayipi lomoya okwamanje: bhala DUCT.
set.h: Ukuphakama kokulinganisa amapayipi anxantathu ne-flat oval ({unit})
cmd.ductnet.help: Ukucindezela emnatheni wonke wamapayipi adwetshiwe kusukela ephoyinteni lesiqhubi: indlela ebucayi, i-damper ekugcineni ngakunye, ukucindezela kwesiqhubi (DNET)
net.fan: Isiqhubi noma isiphathi somoya: chofoza ekupheleni komugqa wepayipi oyisebenzelayo [Indlela/Ukucindezela kwempahla]
net.equip: Ukucindezela kwamakhoyili, izihlungi nezinye izinto ({unit}; kubhalwe ngokusuka kumadatha abakhiqizi)
net.err.source: Iphoyinti alisekugcineni komugqa wepayipi lomoya. Chofoza ekupheleni lapho isiqhubi noma isiphathi somoya sixhumeka khona.
net.err.noducts: Akukho mamgqa wamapayipi lomoya kulo mdwebo.
net.err.noterminals: Ayikho imikhawulo yamapayipi lomoya etholakele, ngakho akukho lapho umoya ungahamba khona.
net.err.nofan: Qala i-DUCTNET bese uchofoza isiqhubi, bese uyakhipha.
net.note.noflow: {tag}: ingxenye ekugcineni okukhululekile ayinakho ukugeleza komoya okubhaliwe, ngakho ibalwa njengeziro.
net.note.loop: Kutholakale izikhala zamapayipi {n}. Ukubalwa kulandela isihlahla, ngakho izikhala zinganakwa.
net.head: Imikhawulo: {ends}. Ukucindezela kwesiqhubi: {fan}. Indlela ebucayi iya kwi: {crit}.
net.sizes: Izingxenye {n} zincane ngokwegeleza lomoya lwazo, ziyashesha, noma zincane kakhulu: {list}.
net.defaults: Ukulahleka kwezixhumanisi kusebenzisa izinkomba zokuzenzela ezibhalwe amagama, hhayi isisekelo sedatha yezixhumanisi, futhi kungabhekelwa umphumela wesitaki. Hlola nomhlaziyi wakho ngaphambi kokuthembela kuzo.
